list[dict[str, Any]] | None:\n    \"\"\"Coerce API FactorTemplateEntry models to plain dicts for JSONB storage.\"\"\"\n    if entries is None:\n        return None\n    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = result.append(FactorTemplateEntry.model_validate(entry.model_dump()).model_dump())\n        else:\n            result.append(FactorTemplateEntry.model_validate(dict(entry)).model_dump())\n    return OptionTemplateEntry):\n            result.append(entry.model_dump())\n        elif isinstance(entry, dict):\n            # Accept option_title aliases from YAML/UI\n            raw = dict(entry)\n            if \"alternative_title\" not in raw and \"option_title\" in raw:\n                raw[\"alternative_title\"] = raw.pop(\"option_title\")\n            if \"alternative_description\" not in raw and \"option_description\" in raw:\n                raw[\"alternative_description\"] = raw.pop(\"option_description\")\n            result.append(OptionTemplateEntry.model_validate(raw).model_dump())\n        elif hasattr(entry, \"model_dump\"):\n            result.append(OptionTemplateEntry.model_validate(entry.model_dump()).model_dump())\n        else:\n            result.append(OptionTemplateEntry.model_validate(dict(entry)).model_dump())\n    return Format: code_1:d-abc,code_n:d-xyz\"\"\"\n29:     if raw_value is None or not str(raw_value).strip():\n30:         return {}\n31:     template_ids: dict[str, str] = {}\n32:     for pair in raw_value.split(\",\"):\n33:         pair = pair.strip()\n34:         if not pair or \":\" not in pair:\n35:             continue\n36:         code, sg_id = pair.split(\":\", 1)\n37:         code = code.strip()\n38:         sg_id = sg_id.strip()\n39:         if code:\n40:             template_ids[code] = sg_id\n41:     return template_ids\n42: \n43: def parse_csv_name_list(raw_value: str | list | None) -> list[str]:\n44:     \"\"\"Parse a comma-separated name list. \"\"\"Boot-time dependency-injection integrity verification for the composed FastAPI apps.\n2: \n3: Dependency injection is strictly enforced here, regardless of whether the dependency\n4: data is an input parameter for a given endpoint: the runner refuses to start if any\n5: route is missing the guard its application requires (or carries a guard that would\n6: break its access model).\n7: \n8:   - session app:  every route must depend on the session-JWT guard (or an admin variant)\n9:   - external app: every route must depend on the signed-header guard\n10:   - noauth app:   no route may depend on either guard (no authorization expected)\n11:   - share app:    no route may depend on either guard (share cookie/magic-key gate instead)\n12: \n13: Exemptions: routes tagged 'test-helpers' (non-production only, SessionDep-only by\n14: design) and the public /status probes.\n15: \"\"\"\n16: from fastapi import FastAPI\n17: from fastapi.routing import APIRoute\n18: \n19: from ..depends.check_api_key_dependencies import get_api_key_info\n20: from ..depends.check_user_session_jwt_dependencies import (\n21:     get_current_user,\n22:     get_current_user_customer_admin,\n23:     get_current_user_system_admin,\n24: )\n25: \n26: SESSION_GUARDS = {get_current_user, get_current_user_customer_admin, get_current_user_system_admin}\n27: EXTERNAL_GUARDS = {get_api_key_info}\n28: \n29: EXEMPT_TAGS = {\"test-helpers\"}\n30: EXEMPT_PATH_SUFFIXES = (\"/status\",)\n31: \n32: \n33: def _dependency_calls(route: APIRoute) -> set:\n34:     calls = set()\n35: \n36:     def walk(dependant) -> None:\n37:         calls.add(dependant.call)\n38:         for sub in dependant.dependencies:\n39:             walk(sub)\n40: \n41:     walk(route.dependant)\n42:     return calls\n43: \n44: \n45: def _is_exempt(route: APIRoute) -> bool:\n46:     if EXEMPT_TAGS & set(route.tags or []):\n47:         return True\n48:     return any(route.path.endswith(suffix) for suffix in EXEMPT_PATH_SUFFIXES)\n49: \n50: \n51: def verify_app_dependency_integrity(app: FastAPI, target: str) -> None:\n52:     \"\"\"Raise RuntimeError listing every DI violation on the given app.\"\"\"\n53:     violations: list[str] = []\n54:     for route in app.routes:\n55:         if not isinstance(route, APIRoute) or _is_exempt(route):\n56:             continue\n57:         calls = </v-card-actions>\n      </v-card>\n    </v-dialog>\n  </div>\n</template>\n\n<script setup lang=\"ts\">\nimport type { FactorTemplate, ProjectListSummaryItem } from '~/types/api'\nimport { formatEndDateMdY, localEndTimeIso } from '~/utils/projectEndTime'\nimport {\n  DEFAULT_QUESTIONS_PER_GROUP,\n  clampMaxRecommendedPasses,\n  clampMinExpectedPasses,\n  clampQuestionsPerGroup,\n  defaultQuestionsPerGroupForN,\n  questionBudgetBounds,\n} from '~/utils/sortCompare'\n\nconst route = useRoute()\nconst api = useProjectsApi()\nconst brandingApi = useBrandingApi()\nconst snackbar = useSnackbar()\nconst { requireAdmin, isSystemAdmin, isAdmin, aiFeaturesEnabled } = useAuth()\nconst { apiFetch } = useApi()\nconst suggestingFactors = ref(false)\nconst loadingAiModels = ref(false)\nconst aiCatalog = ref<Array<{ id: string, name: string }>>([])\nconst aiCatalogDefault = ref<string | null>(null)\nconst aiCatalogDefaultIsSystem = ref(false)\nconst aiCatalogError = ref('')\nconst DEFAULT_AI_MODEL_KEY = '__default__'\nconst aiVoterItems = computed(() => {\n  const rows = [\n    { title: 'AI AGENT: Default Model', value: DEFAULT_AI_MODEL_KEY },\n    ...aiCatalog.value.map(m => ({ title: `AI AGENT: ${m.name || m.id}`, value: m.id })),\n  ]\n  const seen = new Set<string>()\n  return rows.filter((row) => {\n    if (seen.has(row.value)) return false\n    seen.add(row.value)\n    return true\n  })\n})\nconst aiVoterHint = computed(() => {\n  if (aiCatalogError.value) return aiCatalogError.value\n  if (!aiCatalog.value.length) return 'Configure an AI provider in Settings, or use the system default model.'\n  return 'Select unique models. maxCompleteView.value = false\n  lastFlushedCount.value = 0\n  if (multiFactorMode.value) {\n    pendingGroup.value = g\n    showGroupIntro.value = true\n    runner.stop()\n  } else {\n  return\n  }\n  error.value = ''\n  if (res.project) {\n    projectTitle.value = res.project.project_title || res.project.project_tag || 'Project'\n    if (res.project.factor_count != null)  count: Math.max(1, Number(projectSettings.value.partial_flush_count || 5)),\n    idleMs: Math.max(5, Number(projectSettings.value.partial_idle_seconds || 90)) * 1000,\n  }\n}\n\nasync function lastFlushedCount.value = pkg.pairings.length\n  } catch { /* best-effort */ }\n}\n\nwatch(\n  () => [runner.group.value, runner.pairings.value, runner.inGroupDone.value] as const,\n  () => paused.value = false\n  runner.setPaused(false)\n}\n\nasync function continuePastMax() {\n  maxCompleteAcknowledged.value = true\n  maxCompleteView.value = false\n  const held = heldNextGroup.value\n Load customer for credentials\n    from ...pvf.bindings.pvf_services import Customer\n\n    customer = Customer.get_customer_by_id_system(session=session, id=int(job.customer_id), clear_lock=False)\n    if customer is None or not customer_llm_configured(customer):\n        job.status = \"failed\"\n        job.error_summary = \"There is no provider set up for this customer, check settings to enable\"\n        job.completed_date = datetime.now()\n        session.add(job)\n        session.commit()\n        ut.show_vars_semi(f\"reword job {job.id} failed - no provider\", project_id=job.project_id)\n        return True\n    creds = resolve_llm_credentials(customer)\n    if creds is None or creds.source != \"customer\":\n        job.status = \"failed\"\n        job.error_summary = \"There is no provider set up for this customer, check settings to enable\"\n        job.completed_date = datetime.now()\n        session.add(job)\n        session.commit()\n        return True\n\n    # Load item\n    try:\n        if job.item_type == \"option\":\n            row = session.get(CustomerProjectAlternatives, job.item_id)\n            if row is None or row.deleted_date is not None:\n                raise ValueError(\"Option not found\")\n            messages = option_rewrite_messages(title=row.alternative_title or \"\", description=row.alternative_description)\n        else:\n            row = session.get(CustomerProjectFactors, job.item_id)\n            if row is None or row.deleted_date is not None:\n                raise ValueError(\"Factor not found\")\n            messages = factor_rewrite_messages(\n                title=row.factor_title or \"\",\n                description=row.factor_description,\n                polarity_positive=row.factor_polarity_positive,\n                polarity_note=row.factor_polarity_note,\n            )\n        payload = chat_json_sync(\n            messages=messages,\n            temperature=0.3,\n            max_tokens=300,\n            provider=creds.provider,\n            model=creds.model,\n            api_key=creds.api_key,\n        )\n        parsed = parse_compare_prompt(payload)\n        if not parsed:\n            # fallback: try raw payload string?\n            if isinstance(payload, dict):\n                # try any string value\n                for v in payload.values():\n                    if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():\n                        parsed = parse_compare_prompt({\"compare_prompt\": v})\n                        if parsed:\n                            break\n            if not parsed:\n                raise AiProviderError(\"Could not parse compare prompt\")\n        _update_target(session, job, parsed)\n        job.status = \"complete\"\n        job.completed_date = datetime.now()\n        job.modify_date = datetime.now()\n        session.add(job)\n        session.commit()\n        ut.show_vars_semi(f\"reword job {job.id} complete\", project_id=job.project_id, item_type=job.item_type, prompt=parsed[:80] if parsed else \"\")\n        return True\n    except AiProviderError as ex:\n        if ex.retryable:\n            # requeue to queued with backoff? For now mark failed retryable -> queued again\n            job.status = \"queued\"\n            job.error_summary = str(ex) or \"AI service is unavailable\"\n            job.modify_date = datetime.now()\n            session.add(job)\n            session.commit()\n            ut.show_vars_semi(f\"reword job {job.id} retryable\", error=str(ex)[:200])\n            return True\n        job.status = \"failed\"\n        job.error_summary = str(ex) or \"AI provider error\"\n        job.completed_date = datetime.now()\n        session.add(job)\n        session.commit()\n        ut.show_vars_semi(f\"reword job {job.id} failed\", error=str(ex)[:200])\n        return True\n    except Exception as ex:\n        job.status = \"failed\"\n        job.error_summary = str(ex)[:300] or \"Failed to generate compare prompt\"\n        job.completed_date = datetime.now()\n        session.add(job)\n        session.commit()\n        ut.show_vars_semi(f\"reword job {job.id} failed exception\", error=str(ex)[:200])\n        return True\n\n\ndef process_all_pending_sync(session: Session, *, customer, project_id: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Synchronous helper for API fallback: process queued jobs inline.\"\"\"\n    count = 0\n    # loop until no queued for this project\n    while True:\n        job = session.exec(\n            __import__(\"sqlmodel\").sql.sqlmodel.select(ComparePromptJob).where(\n                ComparePromptJob.project_id == project_id,\n                ComparePromptJob.customer_id == customer.id if hasattr(customer, \"id\") else customer.customer_id,\n                ComparePromptJob.status == \"queued\",\n                ComparePromptJob.deleted_date == None,\n            ).order_by(ComparePromptJob.id.asc()).limit(1)\n        ).one_or_none() if False else None\n        # placeholder to avoid import cycle - use direct query\n        break\n    return count\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/workspaces/powerchoice/src/utils/ai/reword_worker.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"src/utils/ai/reword_worker.py","time":{"start":1787340355545,"end":1787340355561}},"metadata":{"openai":{"itemId":"fc_01a025c956927ff1a1581ab301484207"}},"id":"prt_025c9570e0011I9QVaj3i5HzUs","sessionID":"ses_fda38c6caffe0UqRpBB77Q9AEk","messageID":"msg_025c94f25001W3p1JuAcRpDbHa"}}

})\n            continue\n        q = clamp_questions_per_group(budget, n) if n >= 2 else 0\n        batches = partition_item_ids(item_ids, q or 1, channel_rng) if n >= 2 else []\n        for batch_i,     })\n    return slots\n\n\ndef mean_ranks_from_order(rank_order: list[int]) -> dict[int, float]:\n    return {int(item_id): float(i) for i, item_id in enumerate(rank_order)}\n\n\ndef    return total\n\n\ndef build_progress(\n    *,\n    project: Any,\n    groups: list | None,\n    option_ids: list[int],\n    factor_ids: list[int],\n    exclusive_mode: bool,\n    comparisons_done: if not package:\n        return \"Group package required\"\n    client_id = package_group_id(package)\n    if not client_id:\n        return \"group_token is required\"\n    issued_token = package_group_id(issued_group) if issued_group else \"\"\n    if issued_group and issued_token and issued_token != client_id:\n        issued_ids = [int(x) for x in (issued_group.get(\"item_ids\") or issued_group.get(\"item_ids_initial\") or [])]\n        initial = [int(x) for x in (package.get(\"item_ids_initial\") or package.get(\"item_ids\") or [])]\n        if sorted(issued_ids) != sorted(initial):\n            return \"Group does not match the issued compare group\"\n    initial = [int(x) for x in (package.get(\"item_ids_initial\") or package.get(\"item_ids\") or [])]\n    order = [int(x) for x in (package.get(\"rank_order\") or [])]\n    if require_rank_order:\n        if not order:\n            return \"rank_order is required\"\n        if sorted(order) != sorted(initial):\n            return \"rank_order must be a permutation of the group's items\"\n    allowed = set(order or initial)\n    pairings = package.get(\"pairings\") or []\n    if not isinstance(pairings, list):\n        return \"pairings must be a list\"\n    for p in pairings:\n        if not isinstance(p, dict):\n            return \"invalid pairing entry\"\n        w = p.get(\"winner_id\")\n        l = p.get(\"loser_id\")\n        a = p.get(\"item_a_id\")\n        b = p.get(\"item_b_id\")\n        ids = [x for x in (w, l, a, b) if x is not None]\n        if w is None or l is None:\n            if a is None or b is None:\n                return \"each pairing needs a pair of item ids\"\n        if allowed:\n            for x in ids:\n                if int(x) not in allowed:\n                    return \"pairing ids must be in the group\"\n    return None\n\n\ndef normalize_pairing(p: dict) -> dict:\n    resp = p.get(\"response\") or \"winner\"\n    if  \"decision_seconds\": float(p.get(\"decision_seconds\") or p.get(\"decisionSeconds\") or 0.0),\n        \"presented_left_id\": int(p[\"presented_left_id\"]) if p.get(\"presented_left_id\") is not p.get(\"presented_right_id\") is not None else (\n            int(p[\"presentedRightId\"]) if p.get(\"presentedRightId\") is not None else None\n        ),\n        \"item_a_id\": int(p[\"item_a_id\"]) if p.get(\"item_a_id\") is not None else None,\n        \"item_b_id\": int(p[\"item_b_id\"]) if p.get(\"item_b_id\") is not None else None,\n    }\n\n\ndef parse_event_timestamp(raw: Any) -> datetime | None:\n    if raw is None:\n        return None\n    if isinstance(raw, datetime):\n        return raw\n    try:\n        s = str(raw).replace(\"Z\",
